findings.title: Dormant URL class loader instantiates unverified code
findings.entry_point: No shipped entry point supplies untrusted data. The theoretical inputs are the caller-supplied path and classname accepted at ApoClassLoader.java:19-21 and mutable through setters at lines 36-37 and 52-53.
findings.sink: URLClassLoader.loadClass followed by Class.newInstance at ApoClassLoader.java:73-75, which initializes and executes the selected class.
findings.data_path: A caller-provided path is stored by setPath at ApoClassLoader.java:20,52-53; getMyClass converts it to a local URL when B_APPLET is false or accepts it directly as a URL when true at lines 62-69; the caller-provided classname then reaches loadClass and newInstance at lines 73-75.
findings.attack_scenario: This is theoretical in ApoMarc. If reused code invokes this helper with attacker-controlled values, the attacker hosts Payload.class at the supplied URL (or places it in a supplied local directory), selects Payload as the class name, and has its static initializer or constructor execute with the game's process privileges.
findings.preconditions: Additional application code must invoke ApoClassLoader.getMyClass with attacker-influenced path/classname. Remote loading also requires B_APPLET=true; desktop mode instead requires an attacker-controlled local directory. The runtime must permit class loading.
findings.validation_plan: Create a Payload class whose static initializer writes a marker file, serve Payload.class from a local HTTP directory, set ApoConstants.B_APPLET=true in a test harness, and invoke new ApoClassLoader("http://127.0.0.1:8000/", "Payload").getMyClass(). The marker proves code execution. Then confirm that neither ApoMarcMain.main nor ApoMarcApplet.init invokes the harness or loader.

findings.title: Dormant high-score client uses unauthenticated HTTP
findings.code_excerpt:
public final static String HIGHSCORE_GETPHP = "http://www.apo-games.de/apoNotSoSimple/get_highscore.php";
public final static String HIGHSCORE_SAVEPHP = "http://www.apo-games.de/apoNotSoSimple/save_highscore.php";
findings.entry_point: No shipped ApoMarc call site invokes the component. The theoretical network entry point begins when a caller invokes ApoHighscore.save at ApoHighscore.java:55 or load at line 100, allowing the endpoint or an on-path attacker to control cleartext traffic and responses.
findings.sink: URLConnection input/output streams opened over the HTTP URLs at ApoHighscore.java:63-64,72,81 and 109-110,118,126.
findings.data_path: save builds level, points, and name form fields at ApoHighscore.java:74-77 and writes them to HIGHSCORE_SAVEPHP; load posts to HIGHSCORE_GETPHP at lines 109-124 and consumes its response at lines 126-138. Both URL constants use http:// at ApoConstants.java:24-25.
findings.attack_scenario: If this dormant component is invoked, an on-path attacker intercepts port-80 traffic, observes the submitted player name and score, alters the POST body, or replaces the load response with chosen numeric triples and names. The component then exposes the forged values through its lists at ApoHighscore.java:36-45. Actual server-side acceptance of an altered submission was not established.
findings.preconditions: Additional code must call save or load, ApoConstants.B_ONLINE must remain true as initialized at ApoConstants.java:16, the endpoint must be reachable, and the attacker must control the server or network path.
findings.validation_plan:
Run a minimal harness calling ApoHighscore.save and load with JVM HTTP proxy settings pointing to mitmproxy. Observe the plaintext name/points body, replace the load response with "999999
1
attacker
", and verify getPoints(), getLevels(), and getNames() return those injected values. Separately verify the unmodified ApoMarc entry points never call ApoHighscore.

findings.title: Dormant high-score parser crashes or grows without bounds
findings.entry_point: No shipped ApoMarc path invokes load. The theoretical untrusted input is the server-controlled response stream obtained at ApoHighscore.java:126.
findings.sink: Uncaught Integer.valueOf conversions at ApoHighscore.java:131,133 and unbounded ArrayList additions inside the EOF-terminated loop at lines 129-138.
findings.data_path: ApoHighscore.load opens the response at line 126, readLine supplies each server-controlled string at line 129, and the modulo-based parser converts or stores it at lines 130-137. The method catches only MalformedURLException and IOException at lines 141-147, not NumberFormatException.
findings.attack_scenario: If load is invoked, a malicious server or HTTP interceptor returns a nonnumeric first line, causing an uncaught NumberFormatException and terminating the caller. Alternatively, it streams arbitrarily many valid triples or an extremely long line, causing sustained memory growth or blocking until the process becomes unavailable.
findings.preconditions: Additional code must invoke ApoHighscore.load, B_ONLINE must be true, and the attacker must control the HTTP response or network path.
findings.validation_plan:
Invoke ApoHighscore.getInstance().load() from a harness through a controlled HTTP proxy. First return "not-a-number
" and confirm NumberFormatException escapes load. Then, under a small heap such as -Xmx32m, stream repeated "1
1
name
" triples and observe list/heap growth or OutOfMemoryError. Confirm the stock game never invokes load.

notes: All three findings are theoretical and unreachable from the shipped variant. The desktop entry point ignores its args and constructs ApoMarcPanel directly at ApoMarcMain.java:18-33; the applet entry initializes ApoLibraryGame at ApoMarcApplet.java:31-39, whose selector constructs only ApoMarcPanel at apoMarc/ApoLibraryGame.java:52-55. ApoMarcPanel.load creates fixed local models and JAR-image paths at ApoMarcPanel.java:50-84. Repository-wide reference checks found no call sites for ApoClassLoader or ApoHighscore. ApoIO is abstract at ApoIO.java:18,62,105 and has no subclass in this variant, so its file/URL methods do not parse a save or level format. The MD5 helper at ApoHelp.java:275-280 is never called and performs no validation decision. AudioPlayer's HTTP/user.dir branch at AudioPlayer.java:67-70 is unreachable in ordinary execution because BInJAR is final and true at line 19, and ApoSounds itself has no ApoMarc caller. No ObjectInputStream, System.load/native declaration, known .cheat/.mar/.skunk/.defence/.rep format, credential, or secret was present in the 60 supplied Java files.
